g.title: agent_run
g.text: One agent run: the agent advises, the factory decides

g.title: cluster_legend
g.text: Legend

g.title: wf
g.text: Workflow code (in the controller)
chooses the role, the image, the network profile
and builds the prompt: ticket text is data between markers

g.title: act
g.text: activity sandbox_run
image alias · workspace name · command · timeout
network profile · role · needs model access

g.title: pol
g.text: sandbox-launcher validates the request
known image alias · workspace exists and is not a symlink
env names · timeout cap · profile exists

g.title: rej
g.text: refused, never retried

g.title: pol->rej
g.text: violation

g.title: box
g.text: disposable container (fixed by the launcher, not by the request)
non-root · read-only root · all capabilities dropped · no-new-privileges
memory · CPU · process limits · tmpfs /tmp
mounts: the workspace (read-only or writable) · the agents folder (read-only)
the ChatGPT login only for model runs
network: none, or one internal network with its own proxy

g.title: pol->box
g.text: ok

g.title: run
g.text: opencode run --agent <role> --format json
the role file sets permissions (and, if it wants, model and variant)

g.title: proxy
g.text: egress-proxy
only the hosts of that profile

g.title: run->proxy
g.text: HTTPS only

g.title: out
g.text: exit code · stdout (OpenCode events)
container removed, even on cancel or timeout

g.title: pars
g.text: controller extracts the final text
and sums tokens and cost for the record

g.title: val
g.text: strict JSON validator for that role
shape · allowed values · size limits · safe paths

g.title: retry
g.text: one retry that quotes the exact error

g.title: val->retry
g.text: invalid

g.title: next
g.text: the workflow decides the next step in code
from the verdict value; checks the agent's claims itself
(files exist, tests fail then pass, ...)

g.title: val->next
g.text: valid

g.title: retry->wf
g.text: second attempt

g.title: stop
g.text: a person is asked (comment on the ticket)

g.title: retry->stop
g.text: still invalid

g.title: agl1
g.text: agent (a role file in a sandbox)

g.title: agl2
g.text: factory code decides or checks

g.title: agl3
g.text: deterministic check the factory runs itself

g.title: agl4
g.text: a person
